answer: A farm faking 311 aliases needs 311 separate attestation records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Notary public appointment with deed attestation record is the check: deeds attested by one notary across many years. The oasis check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The nadir record is public, the trellis cost is per identity, and 311 aliases cost 311 times one honest seat.
